steps.content: █/16, 3:12 PM, Dean's Office, Banyan Fourth Hospital.
Led by the burly nurse, you and Donald enter a new, unknown office.
Take a seat, please.
The Dean's responsibilities aren't limited to the Fourth; he also manages the First and Second Hospitals, along with the Banyan Medical College. He's stretched pretty thin...
So, I'll be taking care of you this time around.
Just to introduce myself, I'm Jones, the appointed director at the Fourth Hospital.

steps.speaker: Jones
steps.content: What's the occasion for this visit from the Chief of MBCC, if I may ask?
The director of the Fourth Hospital is lounging back, hands clasped together, sporting a laid-back grin. He seems totally unaware of the bombshell you're about to drop.

steps.speaker: Jones
steps.content: Negotiations?
You skip all the niceties and go right for the heart of the matter, leaving Jones momentarily taken aback.

steps.speaker: Jones
steps.content: I don't quite follow you...

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Drop the pretense. You're well aware of our purpose here.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Bring Margaret out, process her hospital transfer, and do it quick. We don't have all day.

steps.speaker: Jones
steps.content: Margaret, is it... Heh, interesting...
Jones removes his glasses, giving them a quick wipe.

steps.speaker: Jones
steps.content: Haha, Chief, are you interested in hearing what your Sinner has to say?

steps.speaker: Jones
steps.content: Time to face reality. A fugitive from Nirvana, swaggering into Banyan Fourth Hospital to lay down conditions with me?
Whatever he says, consider it coming from me.
The director stares intently at both of you. Following a brief, tense silence, he suddenly erupts into loud laughter.

steps.speaker: Jones
steps.content: ...Hahaha.
Jones theatrically dabs at his eye, as if he's just heard the funniest joke ever.

steps.speaker: Jones
steps.content: Let's cut to the chase, Margaret is definitely in our custody...

steps.speaker: Jones
steps.content: But on what grounds do you reckon you're in a position to bargain with me?!
Behind, the towering nurse steps forward, a threatening glare on his face.

steps.speaker: Jones
steps.content: Taking Margaret with you? Sure, but this guy stays behind...

steps.speaker: Jones
steps.content: I'm sure you know the high price on his head. Nirvana will be thrilled...

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Heh, sorry, I'm not keen on returning to your creepy joint.

steps.speaker: Jones
steps.content: The minute you entered the Fourth Hospital, you lost control of the situation.

steps.speaker: Jones
steps.content: Das managed to keep your last visit a secret, but this time, you won't have the same luck.
Upon hearing that, Donald retreats a step, ducking behind you.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: So, is the Fourth Hospital thinking of making a move on the MBCC Chief?

steps.speaker: Jones
steps.content: Not at all. Given the Chief's present standing, who'd dare make a move on him?
steps.female_content: Not at all. Given the Chief's present standing, who'd dare make a move on her?

steps.speaker: Jones
steps.content: But capturing a criminal on Nirvana's most-wanted list doesn't sound all that difficult, right?

steps.speaker: Jones
steps.content: Sure, as an S-Class Sinner and with the MBCC Chief in tow... if you really insist on leaving, stopping you might be beyond us.

steps.speaker: Jones
steps.content: Just remember, the aunt you're dying to bust out is still in our clutches.

steps.speaker: Jones
steps.content: See, Syndican, it's your call now—scurry back with your Chief and wait for the bad news about the old woman...

steps.speaker: Jones
steps.content: Or, like ten years back, be the hero again, swapping your freedom for your aunt's?

steps.speaker: Jones
steps.content: Go ahead, decide.
This director's face is plastered with a sickening grin, seemingly certain of his triumph.
Yet, Donald just lets out a low chuckle.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Sorry, pal, I'm not keen on either option.
Jones's expression turns stormy in a flash.

steps.speaker: Jones
steps.content: Heh, that's quite the bummer...

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Easy there, tiger. Curious why I knew it was your trap but still waltzed right into it with Chief in tow?

steps.speaker: Jones
steps.content: I don't need the details. What matters is you shot down my proposal...

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Ah, hold up! It's not me turning you down; you're the one who's dissing our proposal.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Remember what we said at the beginning? We're here to negotiate. Yet, you tuned out our fair offers, hell-bent on making this messy...

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: But hey, in a negotiation, it's not just you who's got cards to play, got it?
Donald fishes out a videotape from his backpack and slaps it on the table.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Here, give this a watch.

steps.speaker: Jones
steps.content: ...What's that?
Looks like Donald's unexpected show of force has thrown the director off his game, making him falter as he asks.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Why not just watch and find out?
The director flicks a knowing glance at the nurse, who swiftly pops the tape into the projector next to them.
Then, an image flickers to life on the screen.
Through the glass, the patient in the bed jerks a bit and then goes still.

steps.speaker: Researcher A
steps.content: Great, he's gone.

steps.speaker: Researcher B
steps.content: I said to ease up on the juice, to take it easy, but no, you had to go your own way!

steps.speaker: Researcher A
steps.content: It's all because the top brass won't stop hounding us for results...

steps.speaker: Researcher B
steps.content: Ah well, let's not sweat it. One thing's for sure, our Fourth Hospital has no shortage of guinea pigs.

steps.speaker: Researcher A
steps.content: Hurry up and bring down a few more. If we hold up Nirvana's data crunchers, we're in deep trouble...

steps.speaker: Jones
steps.content: Hey!
As soon as he catches sight of that scene, the director jumps up and hastily shuts off the projector.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Hey, why the sudden pause, "Director"?

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: The best parts are still ahead.
The director, barely containing his breath, demands with a menacing edge:

steps.speaker: July 26, N.F. 115 20:00
steps.content: How on earth did you stumble upon this...
Donald throws up his hands.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Don't sweat the details.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: The bottom line is, we've got these tapes. And that's not all—we've got more proof up our sleeves. Enough to show the world that your Fourth Hospital is nothing but a monstrous place that tramples on human decency and ethics.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: If you want to keep this under wraps, then play ball and meet our demands...

steps.speaker: Jones
steps.content: Dream on!

steps.speaker: Jones
steps.content: Banyan Fourth Hospital... Nirvana doesn't play these games. Your so-called "proof" can't touch us.
...Still acting all hard-nosed, huh?
You glance at Donald, pretending to be at a loss. Together, you both shake your heads and let out a sigh.
Well, if this was six months back, that attitude might have worked.
But, have you seen what's going down in Eastside lately?
Donald chimes in with your line of thought.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: All these politicians and bigwigs are hustling to cut deals and make alliances with us in the West District... scared stiff of not seeming firm enough or not making enough waves in the media.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: And here's your secret lab, still playing with fire—experimenting on people, snatching folks from the West District for torture... Boy, if this ever leaks, it'll be a real spectacle for those political showboaters.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Better mull it over, because you guys really aren't in a position to say no.
The director goes quiet.
He ponders for what seems like ages, before finally eking out a few words:

steps.speaker: Jones
steps.content: I don't have the clearance for this... I need to check with the dean.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Could've just said you weren't the big boss. It would've spared us the hassle of yapping with a minion like you.
Brushing off Donald's taunt, the director reaches for the desk phone. After a short pause, an unfamiliar voice echoes from the other end.

steps.speaker: Dean
steps.content: What is it?

steps.speaker: Jones
steps.content: Madam, MBCC's Chief... plus that Rustfire fugitive who showed up earlier are here.

steps.speaker: Jones
steps.content: They're trying to blackmail our Fourth Hospital, insisting we transfer that new patient from the West District.

steps.speaker: Dean
steps.content: A transfer? Heh...
A sly chuckle echoes from the other end of the line.

steps.speaker: Dean
steps.content: Where to, exactly?

steps.speaker: Dean
steps.content: I'm pretty sure Ms. Margaret's got mental exhaustion and Alzheimer's caused by Mania, right?

steps.speaker: Dean
steps.content: Banyan Fourth Hospital is the top mental health facility in DisCity. You want to transfer her out just like that, doubting our capabilities? That's not going to look good for Banyan's standing.
That call from the dean spells out her attitude loud and clear.
You give your throat a quick clear, ready to pitch the "solution" you have been cooking up.
Madam, if maintaining your reputation is so important, how about setting up a branch in the West District?
Right now, the West District's knee-deep in the Mania mess. How about teaming up with MBCC to set up a fresh hospital in the Fourth Hospital's name?
Let's pull together all the medical assets there, like the famous SALVA Hospital, and work some magic for the folks in the West District...
I've got the perfect pick for the new branch's boss—Dr. Das. He's a Fourth Hospital guy through and through. That's showing good faith, right?
You could even ship over some of the tougher cases from Eastside, and it'll spruce up your hospital's success rates too...

steps.speaker: Dean
steps.content: Hmm...
Madam, what do you think?
But it isn't the dean who answers. Instead, the appointed director cuts in, unable to hold back.

steps.speaker: Jones
steps.content: So, you're proposing that we pay up and do all the work, and even move the Fourth Hospital's resources... the patients, to that place?!
Right, and we'd also like you to close down that secret lab you've got going under.

steps.speaker: Jones
steps.content: So, the Fourth gets nothing out of this?
Isn't a shiny rep a good enough perk?
If you really wanna know, I'm willing to overlook the dirty little secrets of the Fourth Hospital for the time being. Your thoughts?
The line goes dead silent.
Then, after what seems like an eternity, a brief two-word reply breaks the silence.

steps.speaker: Dean
steps.content: Deal.

steps.speaker: Jones
steps.content: Madam, about this...

steps.speaker: Dean
steps.content: Follow their instructions.
The dean's firm tone silences the director's mild objection.

steps.speaker: Dean
steps.content: The Chief of MBCC, huh...

steps.speaker: Dean
steps.content: Can't wait to see you face-to-face.
█/25, 18:20, at the entrance of the West District's Banyan Branch Hospital

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Back it up, back it up, keep going, OK, and stop!

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Careful now, don't roughhouse with the gear—this stuff costs a pretty penny... and yeah, you're the one I'm pointing at!

Donald takes charge, guiding the movers as they carefully offload the brand-new medical equipment from the truck. He swiftly moves on to coordinate with the hospital staff on the ground floor for checking and inventorying the equipment.
Once done with all this, Donald, wiping away the beads of sweat on his brow, finally turns his attention to you, seemingly noticing you for the first time.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Ah, what's up? Got some time to spare today, huh?
Thought I'd swing by and see how the hospital's coming along.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Don't sweat it, everything's right on track.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Just took a run to satellite town a few days back. Picked up some fancy new medical gear—should take some of the pressure off Das and his crew...
Donald stretches out, yawning effortlessly.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Man, once we're past this hectic period, it looks like we'll have a break from the hospital hustle.
So, are you planning to take a break anytime soon?

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Take a break? Not a chance. I've got a ton of stuff lined up in satellite town and Outland...

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Folks like us? We're wired for the grind, always on the move.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Thankfully... it's all paying off.
In the dying light of the sun, the workers bustling at the hospital's entrance, the crane still humming away in the background... everything's cast in this warm, golden-red glow.
Yes...
You've been working your socks off, Big Hero.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Hey, drop the hero talk, will you? That's a mantle I'm not ready to wear.
Donald quickly waves off the suggestion.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Seriously, if you're lining up the West District's heroes by their achievements, I'm nowhere near the top.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Just your average Joe here. Had my ups and downs, a few slip-ups along the way. Made it this far by a stroke of luck... These days, I'm just trying to pitch in where I can, make some use of what's left in the tank.
...Sounds a bit cheesy.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: It's heartfelt, really.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: These days, all I'm thinking about is networking for the West District, making a few more "friends," leveraging that for better deals...

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Kind of amusing to think back: A decade ago, I wouldn't have known the first thing about this stuff. Just brawling and causing a ruckus all day, and in my wilder moments, roping others into my shenanigans.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: These days, with the West District crying out for a revamp and understaffed at every turn... What can you do? It's sink or swim, learning as you go.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: In moments like these, I can't help but think of Julien... The West District right now, it's just the right place for a brainy guy like him...

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Ah, never mind all that. I nearly let the real business slip my mind.
Donald leaps onto the truck, fishes around in the back, and pulls out a bunch of flowers.
So, this is the "real business" you were talking about? Who's the lucky girl?

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: How does that even connect?
Donald grumbles, clearly a bit annoyed.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Today's the day... Margaret, my aunt, is finally leaving the hospital!
Donald straightens his hair and steps closer to inquire:

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: And?
Think about what?

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: About me—do I look sharp right now, or what?
Looks the same as always to me...

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Really? But I got a new hairstyle and everything. Was that just a waste of money?
You laugh a little at the hint of annoyance on Donald's face.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Enjoying my little crisis, are you?
Nah, I'm just wondering—what's up with the sudden hairdo? It doesn't seem like your thing.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: All this fuss? It's just for my beloved aunt, you know.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Think about it—when I last bumped into Margaret, she had no clue who I was...

steps.speaker: To the great victory of good over evil, and to the upcoming full exposure of those scum. Cheers!
steps.content: So, looking at it through her eyes, today's pretty much a decade-long-awaited reunion, right?

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: I mean, as her nephew, I've got to step up my game, right? Gotta make a solid impression on the old folks...

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: Hey, you little troublemaker, what are you cooking up about me this time?
At the sound of that elderly but gentle voice behind him, Donald straightens up in a snap, alert and tense.
A beat later, gathering his resolve, he turns around, his face blossoming into a bashfully green, boyish grin.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Aunt Margaret...

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: Oh, you remember I'm your aunt, do you?
The old woman, shaky and frail, makes her way over, her cane lightly thumping against Donald.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: Years I've spent looking this way and that, never a sign of you. Where in the world have you disappeared to, you little scamp?
Donald parts his lips, ready to respond to the old woman's question. He has his excuses and stories all lined up, but when push comes to shove, his brain hits a wall, and not a single word comes out.
Somehow, without him realizing it, his eyes have brimmed with tears.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Sorry...

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: Sorry for what? Hey, why the waterworks? Come on, you're grown up now...
Margaret moves closer and tenderly wraps her arms around her nephew.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: Never mind, never mind. You've always been the silent type, keeping everything to yourself... You've probably been through so much.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: The important thing is you're home now, you're home...
